info.title: cyex.tv REST API
info.description: The REST part of the cyex.tv API: sign-in, uploads and the cacheable reads chat clients poll. Everything else is GraphQL at /v1/gql.

get.summary: The service can reach its database.
Start an app sign-in (open this in the browser).
get.description:
Checks the client and the loopback `redirect_uri`, then sends the browser to the cyex.tv
consent page, where the user signs in with Twitch or Kick if needed and allows or denies.
A bad client or redirect answers 400 here and is never redirected to; other mistakes go back
to the redirect as `error=invalid_request` with `state`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Echoed back to the redirect; 1 to 512 characters.

303.description: To the consent page on cyex.tv, or back to `redirect_uri` with `error=invalid_request`.

get.summary: A registered app: its name and scopes, for the consent page.

post.summary: Allow or deny an app (the consent page).
post.description:
Site cookie only, from `https://cyex.tv` (`Origin`); an app token can't consent. Every field of
the authorize request is checked again.

post.summary: Sign an app out by one of its tokens (RFC 7009).
post.description:
Ends the app session the access or refresh token belongs to, refresh tokens included. Answers
200 whether or not the token was known. `POST /v1/auth/logout` with the Bearer token does the
same while the access token is still good.

200.description: Signed out (or nothing to sign out).

post.summary: Trade a code for tokens, or refresh.
post.description:
`grant_type=authorization_code` with `code`, `code_verifier`, `redirect_uri` and `client_id`;
or `grant_type=refresh_token` with `refresh_token` and `client_id`. No client secret: the app
is a public client. A code works once, within 2 minutes; a wrong verifier uses it up. A refresh
token works once; presenting a used one signs the session out.

post.summary: Sign out and end the session.
post.description: With the cookie, the request must come from `https://cyex.tv` (`Origin`).

204.description: Signed out. The session cookie is cleared.

403.description: `bad_origin`: the cookie was sent from another site.

get.summary: Where the platform sends the browser back to.
get.description:
Checks `state` against the cookie set at login, signs in (or links), sets the session cookie
and redirects to `return_to`.

400.description: `bad_state` (bad, expired or used `state`) or `declined` (the user cancelled).

502.description: `platform_error`: the platform didn't answer as expected.

get.summary: Start signing in with Twitch or Kick.
get.description:
Redirects to the platform's consent page and sets a short-lived cookie holding `state`. With
`link=true` and a signed-in session, the identity is linked to the current account instead.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: Where to send the browser afterwards. Must be a cyex.tv URL.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link this platform to the signed-in account instead of signing in.

302.description: Redirect to the platform's sign-in page.

503.description: `unavailable`: sign-in with this platform isn't set up.

get.summary: A channel and its active set ID. Poll this, then fetch the set.

404.description: `not_found`: no cyex.tv account has this channel.

get.summary:
The cyex.tv chat badges and name paints that are for sale in the shop or held by at least one
account (ADR 0015); cosmetics that are neither are left out (staff with a `cosmetics.*`
permission, signed in, get them too). Cache it with `If-None-Match`; live changes come as
`cosmetic.*` events on the `cosmetics` topic.

post.summary: Upload a badge or paint picture (staff, `cosmetics.manage`).
post.description:
The worker makes its files (WebP and AVIF) under `cosmetics/`; poll `cosmeticImage(id)` until
`ready`, then use the ID in `createBadge` or `createPaint`.

Badges follow the cyex badge size ladder: square 18, 36 and 72 px (`1x`, `2x`, `4x`), then
128, 256 and 512 px (`128.webp`, `256.webp`, `512.webp`), all scaled from one 512 px master.
PNG, APNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, square, at least 72×72 px (at most 2048), up to 8 MB. Animated:
at most 120 frames, 10 seconds and 64 MP (width × height × frames), and at most 512 KB per
chat size once converted; 128, 256 and 512 px animate only within 1, 2 and 4 MB (their
`_static` files always exist). Paints: at least 64 px tall, PNG, APNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, at
most 5 MB.

The same bytes give the same picture again; for a badge made before the larger sizes, they
are made then (as `remakeCosmeticImage` does).

202.description: Accepted; the files are being made.

get.summary:
The badge and paint up to 100 chatters show, as catalog IDs. Only chatters showing something
are listed; changes come as `user.cosmetics_updated` on their `user:` topics.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Up to 100 platform user IDs, comma-separated.

post.summary:
Upload an emote. It starts `pending`: usable in your own sets, hidden from everyone else until a
moderator approves it. Manage it afterwards through GraphQL.
post.description:
PNG, APNG, GIF, WebP (still or animated) or JPEG; at most 8 MB, 1000×1000 px and 1000
frames. Sign in first (with the cookie, from `https://cyex.tv`). At most 20 uploads an hour.
The flags `zero_width`, `private` and `nsfw` may be set at once (each `true` or `false`,
default `false`), and `visibility` (`public`, `unlisted` or `private`; with `private` too,
they must agree); `updateEmote` changes them later. `owner_id` uploads for an account you edit
with `EMOTE_UPLOAD` (ADR 0014): it owns the emote, and the upload counts against both of you.

202.description: Accepted; the files are being made. The emote is `pending`.

403.description: `restricted` (you or the owner you upload for), `forbidden` (no `EMOTE_UPLOAD` there), or `bad_origin` for a cookie from another site.

409.description: `too_many_pending`: the owner already has as many emotes waiting for review as it may (20 unless its roles say otherwise; `uploadQuota`).

415.description: `unsupported_format`: not PNG, APNG, GIF, WebP or JPEG (AVIF isn't taken yet).

429.description: `rate_limited`: the uploads an hour (20 unless the account's roles say otherwise) or the per-IP limit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The emote's ID: its Snowflake (digits), or its old ULID while clients move over.

post.summary: Personal sets for up to 100 chatters at once, for clients rendering a chat.

get.summary: The cyex.tv global set, shown in every channel.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The set's ID: its Snowflake (digits), or its old ULID while clients move over.

post.summary: Paddle's webhook for cyex.tv's own Paddle account (ADR 0016). Not for clients.
post.description:
The raw body is checked against `Paddle-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of `"<ts>:<body>"` with the
endpoint's secret; `ts` within 5 minutes). Each event is handled once, by its `event_id`.
`transaction.completed` fulfils an order, `transaction.canceled` fails a pending one, and an
approved `refund` or `chargeback` adjustment takes the cosmetics back. Other events are
acknowledged and ignored.

200.description: Handled, seen before, or not used.

AccountSummary.description: A short reference to an account, for owners and editors.

id.description: The account's Snowflake ID, as decimal digits (ADR 0026). Its old ULID is still taken as input.

AppClientInfo.description: A registered app and what it asks for.

description.description: For people: "Manage emotes in sets you can edit".

Badge.description: A chat badge, shown before a chatter's name.

allow_personal_emotes.description: Whether other people's personal emotes show in this channel.

platform_channel_id.description: Twitch: the broadcaster's user ID. Kick: `broadcaster_user_id`.

location.description:
Where to send the browser: the app's loopback address with `code` and `state`, or with
`error=access_denied`.

CosmeticCatalog.description: Every badge and paint, for clients to cache (`GET /v1/cosmetics`).

CosmeticImage.description: A badge's or an image paint's picture, served at `{host}/{name}` like emote files.

files.description:
WebP and AVIF at 1x, 2x and 4x, and static first frames for animations. Empty until the
worker made them.

ready.description: The files are made: only then can a badge or paint use it.

channel_count.description: How many channels have this emote in their active set right now.

id.description: The emote's Snowflake ID, as decimal digits (ADR 0026). Its old ULID is still taken as input.

visibility.description:
`PUBLIC`, `UNLISTED` or `PRIVATE` (ADR 0020). `flags.private` says the same for
`PRIVATE`, for clients from before `UNLISTED`.

EmoteFile.description: One file of an emote, served at `{host}/{name}`.

is_static.description: The first frame of an animated emote.

scale.description:
1 to 4. A badge's larger sizes (`128`, `256`, `512`) carry their px ÷ 18, rounded: 7, 14
and 28; read `width` for the size.

private.description: Only its owner can add it to sets. True exactly when `visibility` is `PRIVATE`.

wide.description:
About twice as wide as tall or more: the 1x file is at least 1.75 times as wide as it is
tall. Derived from the files, not set by the uploader.

id.description: The set's Snowflake ID, as decimal digits (ADR 0026). Its old ULID is still taken as input.

listed.description: `visibility` is `LISTED`: shown on the owner's profile.

slots_used.description:
How many of `capacity` the set uses. For whoever may edit the set it counts every emote in
it, pending ones included, so `capacity - slotsUsed` is what still fits. For anyone else it
counts the emotes this answer may show them (approved ones, plus their own pending ones).

visibility.description: Who can find and open it.

EmoteVisibility.description: Who can find an emote and add it to sets (ADR 0020).

ErrorBody.description: An error answer. `error` is a stable code clients can match on; `message` is for people.

OAuthErrorBody.description: An OAuth error answer (RFC 6749 5.2); `message` repeats the description, as elsewhere.

Paint.description: A name paint: a gradient or a picture drawn into the chatter's name.

angle.description: Degrees, 0 to 360, CSS convention (0 points up, 90 to the right). Linear only.

color.description: Shown where a client can't draw the paint.

oneOf.description: Image paints only. 64 px tall at 1x.

stops.description: 2 to 10 for gradients; none for image paints.

PaintShadow.description: A drop shadow under a painted name (CSS `drop-shadow(x y radius color)`, in px).

PaintShape.description: The shape of a radial paint.

PaintStop.description: One colour stop of a gradient paint.

at.description: Where along the gradient, 0 to 1. Each stop is at or after the one before.

user_ids.description: Up to 100 platform user IDs, for example the people seen in chat.

PersonalLookupResult.description: Only users with a non-empty personal set are listed.

token.description: An access or refresh token of the session to sign out.

SetEmote.description: An emote as it sits in a set: the name it is typed as there, and who added it.

name.description: The name in this set. Differs from `emote.name` when the set renamed it.

SetVisibility.description: Who can find and open a set.

refresh_token.description: Single use: each refresh answers a new one. Presenting a used one signs the session out.

redirect_uri.description: With `authorization_code`: the same `redirect_uri` as at authorize.

UploadCosmeticImage.description: Multipart upload (REST only): a badge or paint picture.

UploadEmote.description: Multipart upload (REST only): the image file, its name, and optionally its tags and flags.

nsfw.description: As `zero_width`. Search leaves it out unless asked for NSFW.

owner_id.description:
The account that will own the emote: yours by default, or one you edit with
`EMOTE_UPLOAD` on every set (ADR 0014).

private.description: As `zero_width`. Only its owner can add it to sets, and search leaves it out.

visibility.description:
`public` (default), `unlisted` or `private` (ADR 0020). With `private` too, the two
must agree.

zero_width.description: `true` or `false` (also `1`/`0`, `on`/`off`); default `false`. Drawn over the emote before it.

UserCosmetics.description: What one chatter shows, as IDs from the catalog. Only chatters showing something are listed.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Signing in with Twitch or Kick, and app sign-in for desktop apps (authorization code with PKCE and a loopback redirect, ADR 0021).

tags.name: cosmetics
tags.description: cyex.tv chat badges and name paints (ADR 0015): the catalog, chatters' picks, and staff picture uploads.

tags.name: shop
tags.description: The cosmetics shop (ADR 0016): Paddle's webhook. Items, checkout, orders and codes are GraphQL.

tags.name: reads
tags.description: Public, cacheable reads for chat clients.
